summary: The filing is an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting that the Board of Directors of Ohio Valley Banc Corp. declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share, payable August 10, 2026 to shareholders of record July 24, 2026. The action is a routine capital return via dividend declared by the issuer. No unusual terms, stake changes, or structural mechanics are involved; it is a standard quarterly payment. What to watch: future dividend consistency or any change in payout policy.
